class.name: VFXSequence
class.brief_description: Plays a timed list of effects.
class.description: A [VFXSequence] holds entries of the form [code]{"t": float, "effect": String, "offset": Vector3, "params": Dictionary}[/code], sorted by time. [method advance] fires every entry whose time has passed by calling the spawn callable as [code]spawn.call(effect, origin + offset, params)[/code]. Instances are normally created by [method VFXBindings.make_sequence].

method.name: advance
method.description: Advances the sequence clock by [param dt] seconds and returns how many entries fired.

method.name: configure
method.description: Sets the entries (sorted by [code]t[/code]), the spawn callable, the origin and the parameters merged into every entry, and rewinds the sequence.

method.name: get_duration
method.description: Returns the time of the last entry.

method.name: get_fired_count
method.description: Returns how many entries have fired.

method.name: get_origin
method.description: Returns the origin the entry offsets are relative to.

method.name: is_finished
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when every entry has fired.
